```{r, message = FALSE}
library("AER")
library("wooldridge")
```

### Example 16.5
```{r}
data("mroz")

iv_1 <- ivreg(hours ~ lwage + educ + age + kidslt6 + nwifeinc |
                educ + age + kidslt6 + nwifeinc + exper + expersq,
              data = mroz)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

```{r}
model_1 <- lm(lwage ~ educ + age + kidslt6 + nwifeinc + exper + expersq,
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] == 1, ])

model_2 <- lm(hours ~ lwage + educ + age + kidslt6 + nwifeinc +
                model_1[["residuals"]],
              data = mroz[mroz[["inlf"]] == 1, ])

summary(model_2)
```

### Example 16.6
```{r}
data("openness")

model_1 <- lm(open ~ lpcinc + lland, data = openness)
summary_1 <- summary(model_1)
summary_1
```

```{r}
iv_1 <- ivreg(inf ~ open + lpcinc |
                lpcinc + lland,
              data = openness)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

### Example 16.7
```{r}
data("consump")

iv_1 <- ivreg(gc ~ gy + r3 |
                gc_1 + gy_1 + r3_1,
              data = consump)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```

### Example 16.8
```{r}
data("prison")

model_1 <- lm(gcriv ~ y81 + y82 + y83 + y84 + y85 + y86 + y87 + y88 +
                y89 + y90 + y91 + y92 + y93 + gpris + gpolpc + gincpc +
                cunem + cblack + cmetro + cag0_14 + cag15_17 + cag18_24 +
                cag25_34,
              data = prison)
summary_1 <- summary(model_1)
summary_1
```

```{r}
iv_1 <- ivreg(gcriv ~ y81 + y82 + y83 + y84 + y85 + y86 + y87 + y88 +
                y89 + y90 + y91 + y92 + y93 + gpris + gpolpc + gincpc +
                cunem + cblack + cmetro + cag0_14 + cag15_17 + cag18_24 +
                cag25_34 |
                y81 + y82 + y83 + y84 + y85 + y86 + y87 + y88 +
                y89 + y90 + y91 + y92 + y93 + gpolpc + gincpc +
                cunem + cblack + cmetro + cag0_14 + cag15_17 + cag18_24 +
                cag25_34 + final1 + final2,
              data = prison)
summary_iv_1 <- summary(iv_1)
summary_iv_1
```
